sample_requirement: Representative complete toy with accessible rigid components.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and certification sampling plan.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with toy mechanical-safety test equipment.

test_method: Subject the toy to the prescribed abuse tests applicable to its construction, including drop, tip-over or dynamic-strength testing where relevant.
requirement: The toy shall withstand reasonably foreseeable abuse without creating an unacceptable safety hazard.
acceptance_criteria: After the prescribed abuse sequence, the toy shall meet the applicable post-test safety requirements.
sample_requirement: Representative complete toy; additional samples may be required for configuration-specific abuse tests.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and certification sampling plan.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory equipped for toy abuse and strength testing.

test_method: Apply the prescribed flame test to the applicable toy material or construction under the relevant flammability procedure.
requirement: Applicable toys and toy materials shall meet the specified flammability requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Flame duration, rate of flame spread and other applicable results shall remain within the limits specified by the standard.
sample_requirement: Representative samples of applicable flammable toy materials or complete toy constructions.
frequency: Only when the toy falls within a Part 2 flammability category.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with controlled flammability testing facilities.

test_method: Prepare representative accessible toy material samples and determine migration of the specified elements using the applicable extraction and analytical method.
requirement: Migration of specified elements from accessible toy materials shall not exceed the applicable limits.
acceptance_criteria: Antimony, arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury, selenium and other applicable elements shall comply with the limits in Table 1.
sample_requirement: Representative accessible toy material samples; sampling depends on material, colour and component.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and certification sampling plan.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized chemical testing laboratory with suitable elemental-analysis facilities.

test_method: Determine the actual water capacity of the finished cylinder using the prescribed water-capacity measurement procedure.
requirement: The cylinder shall have the water capacity corresponding to the declared design and nominal capacity requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Measured water capacity shall comply with the applicable tolerance specified by the standard.
sample_requirement: Representative finished LPG cylinder samples.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with facilities for cylinder water-capacity measurement.

test_method: Subject the cylinder to the specified hydrostatic test pressure using the prescribed hydraulic test arrangement and inspect for leakage, deformation or other unacceptable effects.
requirement: The cylinder shall withstand the specified hydrostatic test pressure without unacceptable leakage or permanent deformation.
acceptance_criteria: No leakage, rupture or unacceptable permanent deformation under the prescribed hydrostatic test conditions.
sample_requirement: Representative finished cylinder samples selected according to the prescribed sampling plan.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized cylinder testing laboratory with hydraulic pressure test equipment.

test_method: Apply the prescribed pneumatic test pressure and examine the complete cylinder for leakage at the specified joints and pressure-containing areas.
requirement: The cylinder shall be gas-tight under the specified pneumatic test conditions.
acceptance_criteria: No leakage shall occur during the prescribed pneumatic leakage test.
sample_requirement: Representative finished cylinder fitted with the applicable valve arrangement.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with suitable pneumatic leakage-testing equipment.

test_method: Subject the cylinder to increasing hydraulic pressure in accordance with the prescribed burst-test procedure and determine the pressure and failure characteristics.
requirement: The cylinder shall withstand the specified burst-test requirements and exhibit the required failure characteristics.
acceptance_criteria: Burst pressure and failure mode shall satisfy the applicable requirements of IS 3196 (Part 1):2013.
sample_requirement: Representative cylinder sample designated for destructive burst testing.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory equipped for destructive hydraulic burst testing of gas cylinders.

test_method: Prepare specimens from the parent metal and weld joint and perform the prescribed tensile and bend tests to assess mechanical strength and weld integrity.
requirement: Parent metal and welded joints shall meet the specified tensile, elongation and bend requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Required tensile strength, elongation and bend performance shall comply with Clause 18; no unacceptable weld cracking or failure.
sample_requirement: Test specimens prepared from representative cylinder material and welded joints as prescribed by the standard.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with mechanical testing and weld-specimen preparation facilities.

test_method: Determine the chemical composition of the steel using the applicable chemical or instrumental analytical method.
requirement: The steel shall conform to the specified limits for carbon, sulphur, phosphorus, manganese, silicon, nitrogen and applicable alloying elements for the declared grade.
acceptance_criteria: Each applicable chemical constituent shall be within the grade-specific limits specified in IS 1786:2008 and its applicable amendments.
sample_requirement: Representative sample from the relevant cast/heat or product lot as prescribed by the Product Manual and SIT.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with chemical analysis facilities.

test_method: Measure nominal diameter/dimensions and determine mass per unit length of the reinforcement steel product using the prescribed measurement procedure.
requirement: The product shall conform to the specified nominal size, dimensional tolerances and nominal mass requirements for the declared diameter.
acceptance_criteria: Measured dimensions and mass shall comply with the applicable requirements and tolerances of IS 1786:2008.
sample_requirement: Representative bars or wires of the declared nominal diameter.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with dimensional and mass measurement facilities.

test_method: Perform tensile testing on a representative specimen to determine yield stress, tensile strength, elongation and total elongation at maximum force.
requirement: The declared grade shall meet the specified yield stress, tensile strength, elongation and applicable tensile-strength-to-yield-stress requirements.
acceptance_criteria: All applicable mechanical properties shall meet the minimum or specified grade-specific values in Table 3 of IS 1786:2008.
sample_requirement: Representative specimen from the applicable grade and nominal diameter.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory equipped with a calibrated universal tensile testing machine and extensometer.

test_method: Bend the bar or wire around the specified mandrel through the prescribed angle and examine the test specimen for cracking or other unacceptable failure.
requirement: The product shall withstand the specified bend test conditions for the applicable grade and diameter.
acceptance_criteria: The specimen shall satisfy the prescribed bend requirements without unacceptable cracking or failure.
sample_requirement: Representative bar or wire specimen of the applicable grade and nominal diameter.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with suitable bend-testing arrangement and mandrels.

test_method: Pre-bend the specimen, subject it to the prescribed treatment and re-bend it under the specified conditions, then examine for cracking or failure.
requirement: Where applicable to the declared grade, the product shall withstand the specified re-bend test conditions.
acceptance_criteria: The specimen shall meet the applicable re-bend requirements without unacceptable cracking or failure.
sample_requirement: Representative specimen of the applicable grade and nominal diameter.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with re-bend testing arrangement, mandrels and temperature-controlled conditioning facilities.

test_method: Operate the ceiling fan under the prescribed rated conditions and measure the air delivery using the applicable BIS test arrangement.
requirement: The fan shall deliver the minimum specified air delivery for the applicable fan size and rated operating conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Measured air delivery shall meet or exceed the applicable value specified by IS 374:2019.
sample_requirement: Representative complete ceiling fan of the declared size and configuration.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with suitable fan performance and air-delivery test facilities.

test_method: Operate the fan under the prescribed rated voltage and frequency and measure electrical input power and power factor.
requirement: The measured power input and power factor shall comply with the applicable requirements for the declared fan configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Measured values shall comply with the applicable limits and declared rating requirements of IS 374:2019.
sample_requirement: Representative complete fan with its applicable regulator or control arrangement.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized electrical laboratory with calibrated power and power-factor measurement equipment.

test_method: Measure insulation resistance at the prescribed points and apply the specified high-voltage electric-strength test to the complete fan assembly.
requirement: The insulation system shall provide adequate insulation resistance and withstand the prescribed dielectric stress.
acceptance_criteria: Insulation resistance and electric-strength performance shall comply with the applicable limits specified by IS 374:2019.
sample_requirement: Representative complete fan assembly including applicable control components.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory equipped for insulation-resistance and high-voltage testing.

test_method: Operate the fan continuously under the prescribed rated conditions and measure temperature rise at the specified motor, winding and other relevant points.
requirement: Temperature rise of the motor and relevant components shall remain within the specified limits.
acceptance_criteria: Measured temperature rise shall not exceed the applicable limits specified by IS 374:2019.
sample_requirement: Representative complete ceiling fan of the applicable motor and size configuration.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with controlled thermal and electrical test facilities.

test_method: Operate the fan under the prescribed conditions for the specified endurance duration and evaluate its performance and condition after completion of the test.
requirement: The fan shall withstand the prescribed endurance operation without unacceptable deterioration, electrical failure or mechanical failure.
acceptance_criteria: The fan shall complete the prescribed endurance test and continue to satisfy the applicable safety and performance requirements.
sample_requirement: Representative complete ceiling fan of the declared motor, size and control configuration.
frequency: As specified in the BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with controlled endurance test facilities for ceiling fans.

test_method: Subject the valve fitting to the prescribed hydraulic pressure test and examine the valve body for leakage, rupture or unacceptable deformation.
requirement: The valve fitting shall withstand the prescribed hydrostatic pressure without leakage or structural failure.
acceptance_criteria: No leakage, rupture or unacceptable permanent deformation under the specified test conditions.
sample_requirement: Representative valve fitting sample of the applicable type.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with hydraulic pressure-testing facilities.

test_method: Apply the prescribed pneumatic test conditions and examine the valve body, spindle and relevant sealing interfaces for leakage.
requirement: The valve fitting shall remain leak-tight under the specified pneumatic test conditions.
acceptance_criteria: No unacceptable leakage from the valve body, spindle or sealing interfaces.
sample_requirement: Representative complete valve fitting sample.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with controlled pneumatic leakage-testing equipment.

test_method: Open and close the valve through the prescribed operating cycle sequence and verify continued functional and leak-tight performance.
requirement: The valve shall operate reliably through the specified number of opening and closing cycles without unacceptable degradation.
acceptance_criteria: The valve shall complete the prescribed cycle sequence and continue to satisfy the applicable operational and leak-tightness requirements.
sample_requirement: Representative valve fitting sample of the applicable type.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with automated or controlled valve cycle-testing facilities.

test_method: Apply the prescribed torque to the valve components and verify that the valve retains its structural integrity and functional performance.
requirement: Valve components shall withstand the specified torque without unacceptable damage, leakage or loss of function.
acceptance_criteria: No unacceptable mechanical failure, leakage or loss of required valve operation after the prescribed torque test.
sample_requirement: Representative valve fitting of the applicable variety.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with calibrated torque-testing equipment.

test_method: Apply the prescribed pneumatic pressure and check the valve outlet packing, spindle, valve housing and joint interfaces for leakage.
requirement: The valve fitting shall remain gas-tight at the specified test conditions.
acceptance_criteria: No unacceptable leakage from the specified packing, spindle, housing or joint interfaces.
sample_requirement: Representative complete valve fitting sample.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Product Manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with pneumatic leak-testing facilities.

test_method: Determine insoluble residue, magnesia, total sulphur as SO3, loss on ignition, chloride content and alkali content using the applicable methods referenced by IS 1489 (Part 1):2015.
requirement: Chemical constituents shall conform to the limits specified in Table 1 of IS 1489 (Part 1):2015.
acceptance_criteria: Each specified chemical constituent shall meet the corresponding limit in Table 1.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample suitable for chemical testing.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable cement chemical testing scope

test_method: Determine fineness in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 2).
requirement: Fineness of the cement shall comply with the specified requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Result shall meet the minimum value specified in Table 2 of IS 1489 (Part 1):2015.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample for physical testing.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with cement physical testing scope

test_method: Determine expansion by Le Chatelier and/or autoclave method in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 3), as applicable.
requirement: Cement shall satisfy the specified soundness requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Expansion shall not exceed the limit specified in Table 2 of IS 1489 (Part 1):2015.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample for soundness testing.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable cement soundness testing scope

test_method: Determine initial and final setting time in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 5).
requirement: Initial and final setting times shall comply with the specified requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Initial and final setting times shall fall within the limits specified in Table 2 of IS 1489 (Part 1):2015.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample prepared for setting-time determination.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with cement setting-time testing scope

test_method: Determine compressive strength at the specified ages in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 6).
requirement: Compressive strength at the specified ages shall meet the requirements of Table 2.
acceptance_criteria: Strength at 72 hours, 168 hours and 672 hours shall meet the corresponding limits specified in Table 2.
sample_requirement: Prepared cement mortar specimens from a representative cement sample.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with cement compressive-strength testing scope

test_method: Determine insoluble residue, magnesia, total sulphur as SO3, loss on ignition, chloride content and alkali content using the applicable methods referenced by IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.
requirement: Chemical constituents shall conform to the limits specified in Table 1 of IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.
acceptance_criteria: Each specified chemical constituent shall meet the corresponding limit in Table 1.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample suitable for chemical testing.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable cement chemical testing scope

test_method: Determine fineness in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 2).
requirement: Fineness of the cement shall comply with the specified requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Result shall meet the minimum value specified in Table 2 of IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample for physical testing.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with cement physical testing scope

test_method: Determine expansion by Le Chatelier and/or autoclave method in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 3), as applicable.
requirement: Cement shall satisfy the specified soundness requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Expansion shall not exceed the limit specified in Table 2 of IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample for soundness testing.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable cement soundness testing scope

test_method: Determine initial and final setting time in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 5).
requirement: Initial and final setting times shall comply with the specified requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Initial and final setting times shall fall within the limits specified in Table 2 of IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.
sample_requirement: Representative cement sample prepared for setting-time determination.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with cement setting-time testing scope

test_method: Determine compressive strength at the specified ages in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 6).
requirement: Compressive strength at the specified ages shall meet the requirements of Table 2.
acceptance_criteria: Strength at 72 hours, 168 hours and 672 hours shall meet the corresponding limits specified in Table 2.
sample_requirement: Prepared cement mortar specimens from a representative cement sample.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with cement compressive-strength testing scope

test_method: Assess the applicable safety requirements of IS 17550 (Part 1):2024 for the household refrigerating appliance.
requirement: The appliance shall comply with the applicable safety requirements specified by the standard.
acceptance_criteria: All applicable safety requirements shall be satisfied.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator appliance.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable IS 17550 Part 1 safety scope

test_method: Examine materials, design and manufacture against the applicable requirements of IS 17550 (Part 1):2024.
requirement: Materials, construction and manufacture shall conform to the applicable requirements of the standard.
acceptance_criteria: All applicable construction and material requirements shall be met.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator appliance and relevant components.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 17550 Part 1 scope

test_method: Conduct the storage test in accordance with Clause 6 of IS 17550 (Part 2):2024 under the specified test conditions.
requirement: The refrigerator shall maintain the specified storage temperatures under the applicable test conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Measured storage temperatures shall comply with the applicable limits specified by the standard.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator; test configuration as specified by the standard.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 17550 Part 2 storage-test scope

test_method: Determine cooling capacity and, where applicable, freezing capacity in accordance with Clauses 7 and 8 of IS 17550 (Part 2):2024.
requirement: The refrigerator shall achieve the applicable cooling and freezing performance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Results shall meet the applicable performance criteria specified in Clauses 7 and 8.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator under specified test conditions.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 17550 Part 2 cooling/freezing scope

test_method: Perform the applicable pull-down, temperature-rise and related performance tests specified in IS 17550 (Part 2):2024.
requirement: The appliance shall satisfy the applicable performance limits during transient or abnormal temperature conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Measured temperature behaviour shall comply with the applicable limits and conditions specified by the standard.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 17550 Part 2 performance scope

test_name: Mechanical Safety of Doors, Hinges and Shelves
test_method: Test door or lid seal air tightness, opening force, hinge/handle durability and mechanical strength of shelves and similar components as applicable.
requirement: Doors, hinges, handles, shelves and similar components shall satisfy the specified mechanical and functional requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Each applicable requirement in Clauses 9-12 shall be satisfied.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator with doors, hinges, handles and shelves in production configuration.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable IS 17550 Part 2 mechanical testing scope

test_method: Determine energy consumption using the applicable setup, steady-state/defrost measurements and calculation procedure specified in IS 17550 (Part 3):2025.
requirement: Energy consumption shall be determined under the specified test conditions using the prescribed calculation method.
acceptance_criteria: Determined energy consumption shall be within the applicable limits or declared values required by the applicable regulatory/certification framework.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator configured for energy testing.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: Laboratory with current IS 17550 Part 3 energy-consumption scope

test_method: Determine rated total volume and applicable compartment volumes using Annex H of IS 17550 (Part 3):2025.
requirement: The appliance volume shall be determined in accordance with the prescribed method.
acceptance_criteria: Measured volume shall conform to the applicable determination and declaration requirements of the standard.
sample_requirement: Complete representative refrigerator with production configuration.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: Laboratory with current IS 17550 Part 3 volume-determination scope

test_method: Verify the appliance marking and required product information against the applicable requirements of IS 17550 (Part 1):2024.
requirement: Required markings and product information shall be provided as specified by the standard and applicable BIS certification requirements.
acceptance_criteria: All applicable marking particulars shall be present, legible and compliant.
sample_requirement: Representative production refrigerator and its required marking/label.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 17550 Part 1 marking scope

test_method: Test the safety toe cap for the applicable impact and compression resistance requirements using the methods specified by IS 15298 (Part 2):2024 and its referenced test standards.
requirement: Safety footwear with a protective toe cap shall provide the specified level of protection against impact and compression.
acceptance_criteria: Impact/compression performance and post-test clearance shall satisfy the applicable requirements of the standard.
sample_requirement: Representative pair of safety footwear with production toe-cap configuration.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 15298 Part 2 mechanical testing scope

test_method: Determine penetration resistance of the applicable penetration-resistant insert using the test method specified by IS 15298 (Part 2):2024 and referenced standards.
requirement: Where penetration-resistant protection is claimed, the insert and footwear shall meet the applicable penetration-resistance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Penetration resistance and applicable insert performance shall meet the requirements of the standard.
sample_requirement: Representative pair incorporating the specified penetration-resistant insert.
frequency: Conditional on penetration-resistant footwear classification
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable penetration-resistance scope

test_method: Determine slip resistance on the specified test surface and conditions using the method prescribed in IS 15298 (Part 2):2024.
requirement: Applicable safety footwear shall achieve the specified slip-resistance performance.
acceptance_criteria: Measured slip-resistance values shall comply with the applicable criteria in Table 19.
sample_requirement: Representative pair with production outsole.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 15298 Part 2 slip-resistance scope

test_method: Determine the applicable electrical properties of conductive, antistatic or electrically insulating footwear using the methods referenced by IS 15298 (Part 2):2024.
requirement: Footwear claiming conductive, antistatic or electrically insulating properties shall satisfy the corresponding electrical requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Measured electrical resistance/performance shall fall within the applicable limits for the declared footwear property.
sample_requirement: Representative pair of footwear configured for the claimed electrical property.
frequency: Conditional on declared electrical property
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable electrical-property testing scope

test_name: Water Resistance and Upper Water Penetration
test_method: Determine footwear water resistance and, where applicable, upper water penetration and absorption using the applicable methods specified by IS 15298 (Part 2):2024.
requirement: Footwear claiming the applicable water-resistance characteristics shall meet the specified water-performance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Water-resistance and penetration/absorption results shall comply with the applicable requirements.
sample_requirement: Representative pair with production upper and outsole construction.
frequency: Conditional on applicable water-resistance claim/classification
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 15298 Part 2 water-resistance scope

test_method: Determine flexing resistance of the applicable footwear construction using the method specified by IS 15298 (Part 2):2024.
requirement: The footwear shall withstand the specified flexing test without unacceptable cracking or failure.
acceptance_criteria: The footwear shall satisfy the applicable flexing-performance requirement after the specified number of cycles.
sample_requirement: Representative pair of production footwear.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with applicable flexing-resistance scope

test_method: Verify required footwear markings against Clause 7 and Table 20 of IS 15298 (Part 2):2024.
requirement: The safety footwear shall carry the required product, size, identification and protection markings.
acceptance_criteria: All applicable markings shall be present, legible and compliant with Table 20.
sample_requirement: Representative production pair with final marking.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing
facility_requirement: BIS-recognized laboratory with IS 15298 Part 2 marking scope
